correctness.rationale: For \(G=V\rtimes\langle s\rangle\) with inversion, a generating set containing reflections \(bs\) generates precisely the span of its translations together with the differences of reflection labels, semidirect the first reflection. This gives \(d(G)=t+1\). Two translations extend to a minimum generating set exactly when linearly independent; a nonzero translation and a reflection always extend; and two distinct reflections always extend because their product gives a nonzero translation. The resulting join decomposition and degree formulas follow directly, as does the element-order divisibility statement.
residual_risks: No correctness defect is asserted; rejection is originality/value based.
